Type.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/7] The first author followed up on how the participants felt after the study and since the phenomenon is a sensitive issue, a psychologist was recruited, and it was explained to the participants that if they experienced discomfort following the interview, the psychologist was available for them.

Area.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/5] the men said that they experienced neither shame nor prejudice, which they related having been afraid of before the interviews. [/page/2/Text/7] All the participants said participating in the study was a relief for them. They felt it was good to be able to disclose their difficult experience where they were uninterrupted and could just tell their story. This said, they related that at the time of the interviews they experienced some strain and stress but afterwards they experienced relief and had greater well-being.
